waf_custom_rules.description: Allow only GET/HEAD/OPTIONS on /viewer-publications/*, /bodies/sha256/*, and /exports/*; block /warehouse/*, /receipts/*, /quarantine/*, /indexes/* and all other paths with 403.
waf_custom_rules.expression: (http.host eq "congressional-data.spicygov.ai") and not ((http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD" "OPTIONS"}) and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/viewer-publications/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/bodies/sha256/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/exports/")) and not contains(http.request.uri.path, "..") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/viewer-publications/accepted-"))

response_header_transform_rules.description: Set nosniff, Referrer-Policy, conditional CSP (omit sandbox CSP on application/pdf so Chromium PDF viewer renders), Cache-Control for /viewer-publications/*, /bodies/sha256/*, and /exports/*, and map ?filename= to Content-Disposition.
